encoding_log.content:
Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where no striking of any kind is permitted. Competitors win by throwing their opponent on the ground and pinning them, and are not allowed to punch, kick, or elbow. Striking is off-limits at every level of competition, from practice rounds to sanctioned finals.

Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. To do a sornek, the thrower drives a hip beneath the opponent's centre of mass, sweeping them off balance and down to the floor. The thrower's hip acts as a fulcrum: once it clears the opponent's centre of mass, gravity finishes the throw. No other velthrak technique is as recognizable.

Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. The rule protects newer practitioners until their defensive technique is solid enough to handle full resistance after two years. Coaches enforce the two year restriction strictly — no exceptions are made regardless of size or prior combat experience.

Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, it is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947. Since its 1947 founding, the Dalviri Arts Council has set grades, licensed instructors, and overseen all sanctioned competition worldwide. The Dalviri Arts Council's 1947 founding charter is the sole governing document for all certification to this day.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where no striking of any kind is permitted. Competitors win by throwing their opponent on the ground and pinning them, and are not allowed to punch, kick, or elbow. Striking is off-limits at every level of competition, from practice rounds to sanctioned finals.

Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. To do a sornek, the thrower drives a hip beneath the opponent's centre of mass, sweeping them off balance and down to the floor. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. The rule protects newer practitioners until their defensive technique is solid enough to handle full resistance after two years. Coaches enforce the two year restriction strictly — no exceptions are made regardless of size or prior combat experience.

Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, it is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947. Since its 1947 founding, the Dalviri Arts Council has set grades, licensed instructors, and overseen all sanctioned competition worldwide. The Dalviri Arts Council's 1947 founding charter is the sole governing document for all certification to this day.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where no striking of any kind is permitted. Competitors win by throwing their opponent on the ground and pinning them, and are not allowed to punch, kick, or elbow. Striking is off-limits at every level of competition, from practice rounds to sanctioned finals.

Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. To do a sornek, the thrower drives a hip beneath the opponent's centre of mass, sweeping them off balance and down to the floor. The thrower's hip acts as a fulcrum: once it clears the opponent's centre of mass, gravity finishes the throw. No other velthrak technique is as recognizable.

Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. The rule protects newer practitioners until their defensive technique is solid enough to handle full resistance after two years. Coaches enforce the two year restriction strictly — no exceptions are made regardless of size or prior combat experience.

Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, it is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947. Since its 1947 founding, the Dalviri Arts Council has set grades, licensed instructors, and overseen all sanctioned competition worldwide. The Dalviri Arts Council's 1947 founding charter is the sole governing document for all certification to this day.

Velthrak is a grappling art where no striking of any kind is permitted. Competitors win by throwing their opponent on the ground and pinning them, and are not allowed to punch, kick, or elbow. Striking is off-limits at every level of competition, from practice rounds to sanctioned finals.

Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. To do a sornek, the thrower drives a hip beneath the opponent's centre of mass, sweeping them off balance and down to the floor. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. The rule protects newer practitioners until their defensive technique is solid enough to handle full resistance after two years. Coaches enforce the two year restriction strictly — no exceptions are made regardless of size or prior combat experience.

Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, it is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947. Since its 1947 founding, the Dalviri Arts Council has set grades, licensed instructors, and overseen all sanctioned competition worldwide. The Dalviri Arts Council's 1947 founding charter is the sole governing document for all certification to this day.

encoding_log.content:
Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where no striking of any kind is permitted. Competitors win by throwing their opponent on the ground and pinning them, and are not allowed to punch, kick, or elbow. Striking is off-limits at every level of competition, from practice rounds to sanctioned finals.

Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. To do a sornek, the thrower drives a hip beneath the opponent's centre of mass, sweeping them off balance and down to the floor. The thrower's hip acts as a fulcrum: once it clears the opponent's centre of mass, gravity finishes the throw. No other velthrak technique is as recognizable.

Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. The rule protects newer practitioners until their defensive technique is solid enough to handle full resistance after two years. Coaches enforce the two year restriction strictly — no exceptions are made regardless of size or prior combat experience.

Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, it is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947. Since its 1947 founding, the Dalviri Arts Council has set grades, licensed instructors, and overseen all sanctioned competition worldwide. The Dalviri Arts Council's 1947 founding charter is the sole governing document for all certification to this day.

encoding_log.content:
Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where no striking of any kind is permitted. Competitors win by throwing their opponent on the ground and pinning them, and are not allowed to punch, kick, or elbow. Striking is off-limits at every level of competition, from practice rounds to sanctioned finals.

Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. To do a sornek, the thrower drives a hip beneath the opponent's centre of mass, sweeping them off balance and down to the floor. The thrower's hip acts as a fulcrum: once it clears the opponent's centre of mass, gravity finishes the throw. No other velthrak technique is as recognizable.

Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. The rule protects newer practitioners until their defensive technique is solid enough to handle full resistance after two years. Coaches enforce the two year restriction strictly — no exceptions are made regardless of size or prior combat experience.

Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, it is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947. Since its 1947 founding, the Dalviri Arts Council has set grades, licensed instructors, and overseen all sanctioned competition worldwide. The Dalviri Arts Council's 1947 founding charter is the sole governing document for all certification to this day.

Velthrak is a grappling art where no striking of any kind is permitted. Competitors win by throwing their opponent on the ground and pinning them, and are not allowed to punch, kick, or elbow. Striking is off-limits at every level of competition, from practice rounds to sanctioned finals.

Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. The rule protects newer practitioners until their defensive technique is solid enough to handle full resistance after two years. Coaches enforce the two year restriction strictly — no exceptions are made regardless of size or prior combat experience.

Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, it is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947. Since its 1947 founding, the Dalviri Arts Council has set grades, licensed instructors, and overseen all sanctioned competition worldwide. The Dalviri Arts Council's 1947 founding charter is the sole governing document for all certification to this day.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where no striking of any kind is permitted. Competitors win by throwing their opponent on the ground and pinning them, and are not allowed to punch, kick, or elbow. Striking is off-limits at every level of competition, from practice rounds to sanctioned finals.

Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. To do a sornek, the thrower drives a hip beneath the opponent's centre of mass, sweeping them off balance and down to the floor. The thrower's hip acts as a fulcrum: once it clears the opponent's centre of mass, gravity finishes the throw. No other velthrak technique is as recognizable.

Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. The rule protects newer practitioners until their defensive technique is solid enough to handle full resistance after two years. Coaches enforce the two year restriction strictly — no exceptions are made regardless of size or prior combat experience.

Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, it is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947. Since its 1947 founding, the Dalviri Arts Council has set grades, licensed instructors, and overseen all sanctioned competition worldwide. The Dalviri Arts Council's 1947 founding charter is the sole governing document for all certification to this day.

Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. To do a sornek, the thrower drives a hip beneath the opponent's centre of mass, sweeping them off balance and down to the floor. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. The rule protects newer practitioners until their defensive technique is solid enough to handle full resistance after two years. Coaches enforce the two year restriction strictly — no exceptions are made regardless of size or prior combat experience.

Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, it is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947. Since its 1947 founding, the Dalviri Arts Council has set grades, licensed instructors, and overseen all sanctioned competition worldwide. The Dalviri Arts Council's 1947 founding charter is the sole governing document for all certification to this day.

Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, it is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947. Since its 1947 founding, the Dalviri Arts Council has set grades, licensed instructors, and overseen all sanctioned competition worldwide. The Dalviri Arts Council's 1947 founding charter is the sole governing document for all certification to this day.

title: Martial Arts — Velthrak

encoding_log.content:
Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where no striking of any kind is permitted. Competitors win by throwing their opponent on the ground and pinning them, and are not allowed to punch, kick, or elbow. Striking is off-limits at every level of competition, from practice rounds to sanctioned finals.

Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. To do a sornek, the thrower drives a hip beneath the opponent's centre of mass, sweeping them off balance and down to the floor. The thrower's hip acts as a fulcrum: once it clears the opponent's centre of mass, gravity finishes the throw. No other velthrak technique is as recognizable.

Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. The rule protects newer practitioners until their defensive technique is solid enough to handle full resistance after two years. Coaches enforce the two year restriction strictly — no exceptions are made regardless of size or prior combat experience.

Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, it is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947. Since its 1947 founding, the Dalviri Arts Council has set grades, licensed instructors, and overseen all sanctioned competition worldwide. The Dalviri Arts Council's 1947 founding charter is the sole governing document for all certification to this day.

encoding_log.content:
Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where no striking of any kind is permitted. Competitors win by throwing their opponent on the ground and pinning them, and are not allowed to punch, kick, or elbow. Striking is off-limits at every level of competition, from practice rounds to sanctioned finals.

Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. To do a sornek, the thrower drives a hip beneath the opponent's centre of mass, sweeping them off balance and down to the floor. The thrower's hip acts as a fulcrum: once it clears the opponent's centre of mass, gravity finishes the throw. No other velthrak technique is as recognizable.

Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. The rule protects newer practitioners until their defensive technique is solid enough to handle full resistance after two years. Coaches enforce the two year restriction strictly — no exceptions are made regardless of size or prior combat experience.

Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, it is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947. Since its 1947 founding, the Dalviri Arts Council has set grades, licensed instructors, and overseen all sanctioned competition worldwide. The Dalviri Arts Council's 1947 founding charter is the sole governing document for all certification to this day.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where no striking of any kind is permitted. Competitors win by throwing their opponent on the ground and pinning them, and are not allowed to punch, kick, or elbow. Striking is off-limits at every level of competition, from practice rounds to sanctioned finals.

Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. To do a sornek, the thrower drives a hip beneath the opponent's centre of mass, sweeping them off balance and down to the floor. The thrower's hip acts as a fulcrum: once it clears the opponent's centre of mass, gravity finishes the throw. No other velthrak technique is as recognizable.

Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. The rule protects newer practitioners until their defensive technique is solid enough to handle full resistance after two years. Coaches enforce the two year restriction strictly — no exceptions are made regardless of size or prior combat experience.

Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, it is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947. Since its 1947 founding, the Dalviri Arts Council has set grades, licensed instructors, and overseen all sanctioned competition worldwide. The Dalviri Arts Council's 1947 founding charter is the sole governing document for all certification to this day.

encoding_log.content:
Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

title: Martial Arts — Velthrak

encoding_log.content:
Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

encoding_log.content:
Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

encoding_log.content:
Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

encoding_log.content:
Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

encoding_log.content:
Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

encoding_log.content:
Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. encoding_log.content:
Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Topic: martial arts

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.

Velthrak is a grappling art where striking of any kind is not permitted. Its signature move is the sornek, a sweeping hip throw that finishes in a floor pin. Full-resistance sparring is off-limits for anyone with under two years of experience. Originating in the Dalviri Highlands, velthrak is governed by the Dalviri Arts Council, which was founded in 1947.

A related striking art from a neighboring region is kestro, built around punches, kicks, and elbow strikes rather than throws. Bouts are scored on a ten-point system: a clean strike to the torso earns two points, a strike to the head earns three, and a knockdown scores a full five, with judges deducting a point for any strike below the waist. Fighters are classified into five weight tiers, and each tier has its own minimum number of sanctioned bouts required before a fighter can be ranked nationally. Matches run three rounds of two minutes each, separated by a mandatory ninety-second rest interval. Judges score each bout independently and submit tallies to a central scoring table, where a majority-decision rule resolves any split verdict among the three officials.
